bio: Getting there may require some patience, but it's eased by the journey through one of the most enchanting parts of rural, hilly Abruzzo. This family-run restaurant, managed by the Di Tillio brothers (one in the dining room and the other in the kitchen, united by a passion for their work) offers a pleasant outdoor service in summer and takes guests on a journey through the region's culinary traditions. The dishes are often enhanced with produce from the family garden or fresh pasta made with their own wheat flour, with creative touches here and there....
